title: Welcome to the new CloakYourSecrets.com!
body: We're delighted to introduce the next generation of CloakYourSecrets, featuring a redesigned workspace, drag-and-drop file selection, improved guidance and support for ZIP archives of up to 40 MB. All three capacity tiers are free for personal use, without accounts or unlock files. Your ZIP archives, images and author notes are processed locally in your web browser, never uploaded to a server. Your multimedia diary. Your files. Your choice.
